title: Yang-Mills Mass Gap: BT1615-C1 Tightness Proof (BT1621-T1)

theorem.name: BT1621-T1
theorem.statement: The Yang-Mills mass gap bound Delta_m >= (hbar/tau)*0.3326 is TIGHT: achieved by the full 1600-frame Witting SIC-POVM. No proper subset of Witting frames achieves it.
theorem.tightness_argument: Holevo cap of G_W orbit channel = log2(2160) = 11.077 bits. Min info to ID a frame class = log2(2160/168) = 3.684 bits. Gap = log2(40) = 5.322 bits is irreducible without breaking Fano stabiliser. The 168-bin Fano detector (BT1602) is the MINIMAL hardware realisation.
